{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, ensures ideas are captured promptly, and provides a structured way to evaluate and prioritize them.

## Structure
1. **Idea ID** – Unique identifier.
2. **Title** – Short descriptive name.
3. **Description** – Detailed explanation.
4. **Originator** – Who suggested the idea.
5. **Date Added** – When the idea was recorded.
6. **Status** – Current state (e.g., New, In Review, Approved, Rejected, Implemented).
7. **Priority** – Scale 1–5 (1 lowest, 5 highest).
8. **Notes** – Additional comments or next steps.

## How to Add an Idea
- Use the `Add Idea` form in the internal portal.
- Alternatively, add a new entry directly in this document following the structure above.

## Review Process
- Weekly review meetings will discuss ideas with status "New" or "In Review".
- Decisions will be recorded in the **Status** and **Notes** fields.

## Example Entry
```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support
Description: Implement a chatbot that handles common support queries.
Originator: Jane Doe
Date Added: 2026-06-28
Status: In Review
Priority: 4
Notes: Awaiting feasibility study.
```

Feel free to adapt this template as needed.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeasTracker.txt"}

{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, ensures ideas are captured promptly, and provides a structured way to evaluate and prioritize them.

## Structure
1. **Idea ID** – Unique identifier.
2. **Title** – Short descriptive name.
3. **Description** – Detailed explanation.
4. **Originator** – Who suggested the idea.
5. **Date Added** – When the idea was recorded.
6. **Status** – Current state (e.g., New, In Review, Approved, Rejected, Implemented).
7. **Priority** – Scale 1–5 (1 lowest, 5 highest).
8. **Notes** – Additional comments or next steps.

## How to Add an Idea
- Use the `Add Idea` form in the internal portal.
- Alternatively, add a new entry directly in this document following the structure above.

## Review Process
- Weekly review meetings will discuss ideas with status "New" or "In Review".
- Decisions will be recorded in the **Status** and **Notes** fields.

## Example Entry
```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support
Description: Implement a chatbot that handles common support queries.
Originator: Jane Doe
Date Added: 2026-06-28
Status: In Review
Priority: 4
Notes: Awaiting feasibility study.
```

Feel free to adapt this template as needed.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeasTracker.txt"}

Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support

Originator: Jane Doe
Date Added: 2026-06-28
Status: In Review
Priority: 4
Notes: Awaiting feasibility study.
